release_notes: Build 191 fixes the Performance Diagnostics hotspot profiler so its section profiling button appears when the diagnostics page is opened.
Build 191 fixes diagnostics action-plan attachment for the lazily created performance results panel.
Build 191 removes the old startup retry timer used by the hotspot profiler, avoiding unnecessary visual-tree scans during startup.
Performance Diagnostics continues to measure navigation, memory, allocations, and garbage collection behavior.
